charts.title: Compact secant on the eight previously unlaunched roof recordings
charts.caption: This add-only supplement selected exactly the eligible cases that had no launch in the original bounded run. The compact worker used the same prepared request and original 195-second cap. The four capture-era role outcomes come from earlier executions on these same recordings.
